About the job
This is a demo job description written for JobsMatchNow. AWS is hiring a Lead AI Engineer. AWS helps organizations build, deploy, and scale securely in the cloud.

The role
Lead the design and delivery of production AI services on AWS.

What you will do
- Design, build and ship Python and TensorFlow features end to end
- Review code, write tests and keep production healthy
- Work 4 overlapping hours a day with the product team and share progress in writing

What we are looking for
- Solid, recent experience with Python
- Solid, recent experience with TensorFlow
- Solid, recent experience with AWS
- Solid, recent experience with MLOps
- English and Vietnamese for daily work

Nice to have
- Kubernetes
- CI/CD
- Remote collaboration

How to apply
Like this role on JobsMatchNow. If the team likes you back, a conversation opens and you can talk right away.
